summary: Offline Pro license verification in shipped builds, plus maintainer tooling for signing keys and batch license issuance.

changes.title: Production license signing
changes.summary: Shipped builds embed the production signing key so Pro licenses verify fully offline.
user_impact: Import Pro licenses without contacting a server on first verify
Production `.qube-license` files validate against the embedded production key

changes.title: Signing key generator
changes.summary: Maintainers can generate Ed25519 signing keys and register public keys for pack verification.

changes.title: Batch license issuance
changes.summary: Issue multiple customer licenses in one run with a CSV manifest and per-customer key files.
developer_notes: `issue_qube_license.py --count` writes CSV manifest plus QUBE1 serial key files

changes.title: Licensing CLI bootstrap
changes.summary: Licensing maintainer scripts bootstrap the repo root when run directly.
developer_notes: Licensing CLI tools add repo root to sys.path when invoked as scripts
